result.description: Compact wide-format dye-sublimation printer designed for short-run fabric proofs, event backdrops, and boutique apparel transfer work. Includes a 24-inch print path, four-color aqueous dye-sublimation ink set, USB-C and Gigabit Ethernet connectivity, and a heated take-up system for lightweight polyester media. Intended for creative studios rather than graphics or storage hardware.
result.title: Nimble Loom S2 Textile Printer 24in Dye-Sublimation System
